Early on, I co-founded a startup around a peer-to-peer lending application,
designed and built the product, and we sold it to investors within about a year.
It was one of my first companies: a full product taken from idea to build to a
sale, at a point when doing that end to end was still uncommon. The proof here is
simple. I have been shipping and selling real products, not just maintaining
them, from the very start.
